in_hebrew.name: רוחית

in_greek.name: Ανεμοσύνη

in_latin.name: Ventosa
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Windy in Latin is derived from the Latin word ventus, which means 'wind'. The suffix -osa is added to form a feminine noun, resulting in Ventosa, which means 'windy'.
